description_zh: Cruise AV 在路口左转时，与对向直行的电动滑板车发生侧碰。报告显示 AV 让行后脱离自动驾驶模式进行左转，随后滑板车撞上右侧车门。

source_snippets: A Cruise autonomous vehicle ("Cruise AV"), operating in autonomous mode, was traveling northbound on 5th Street and yielding to oncoming traffic before making a left turn onto westbound Howard Street.
The Cruise AV was yielding to an oncoming electric scooterist when the light turned from green to yellow.
shortly thereafter, the electric scooterist made contact with the right side of the Cruise AV, damaging the Cruise AV's front and rear passenger doors.
evidence.reason: 选择 ego 为 Cruise AV 车辆，其左转决策具有测试价值；对向滑板车视为 cyclist，使用现有的 junction_cross 行为表达路口直行冲突。控制信号为 traffic_light，时间明确为凌晨（01:15），天气未知。现有词汇表可覆盖，故返回 supported。
